Rules:
- Translate the block as a coherent passage, not as isolated source lines.
- Do not manually insert @h or speaker names. The tool will wrap lines and create game windows automatically.
- Preserve character voice, narrative flow, and important pauses.
- ASCII apostrophes and contractions are allowed. Do not use curly quotes, em dashes, en dashes, or ellipsis characters.
- The English may be longer or shorter than the Japanese if that improves quality.

prompt_parts.label: Global Style
prompt_parts.content:
Global style:
# Megami Translation Style

Translate into natural English visual-novel prose while preserving the source's pacing and character voice.

Core rules:
- Keep Celica's narration in first person.
- Preserve page rhythm; do not merge or split lines during the pilot.
- Use glossary spellings for names, places, menus, and recurring terms.
- Keep English CP932-safe. Prefer ASCII punctuation.
- Use `...` instead of ellipsis characters and straight quotes instead of curly quotes.
- In the default vanilla text profile, never use apostrophes or contractions.
- In the apostrophe-patched text profile, ASCII apostrophes are allowed.
- Never use em dashes, en dashes, curly quotes, or mojibake punctuation.
- Keep each rendered textbox line at or below 50 visible characters.
- The 50-character limit is a hard technical limit. Shorter and plainer is better than overflowing.
- Speaker pages have one speaker line plus up to 3 dialogue lines.
- Narration pages have up to 4 lines.
- Do not translate script labels unless they are proven visible.
- Translate UI/menu text separately from prose.

Model output rules:
- Return JSON only.
- Return translations keyed by `line_id`.
- Do not invent, remove, or rename line IDs.
- Do not translate speaker names creatively; use glossary names.
- Do not include Japanese in English fields unless a term is intentionally left untranslated.
- If a literal translation is too long, compress it while preserving meaning and tone.

prompt_parts.content:
Character card:
# Celica

Role: protagonist and first-person narrator.

Voice:
- Dry, clipped, masculine, restrained.
- Uses short acknowledgments; avoid stiff "Indeed" unless the scene demands it.
- Calm under danger and absurdity.
- Concern is usually indirect and understated.
- Narration can be reflective, but should not become flowery or melodramatic.

Translation notes:
- Keep his internal monologue economical.
- Do not make him sound hesitant or weak.
- His corrections should be gentle rather than lecturing.

{
  "scene_id": "s1:scene:0009",
  "omitted_earlier_translated_blocks": 30,
  "blocks": [
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02576-02577",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ええ、そりゃあもう私としては大助かりだからいいけど",
      "en": "Well, she's a big help, so I don't mind."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02579-02580",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "頼む……所でシュリは何をしているんだ？",
      "en": "Thanks... By the way, what is Shuri doing?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02582-02582",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "シュリが厨房に消えてから結構な時間が経過している。",
      "en": "Shuri has been in the kitchen for quite some time."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02584-02586",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Rinsha",
      "jp": "ああ、シュリちゃんだったら、セリカの食事を作るって\n張り切っていたわよ",
      "en": "Ah, Shuri? She was raring to cook your dinner."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02588-02598",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺が店に入った時に見せたシュリの表情の意味がやっと判った。\nシュリは幼い頃から俺の家で使用人として働いていた為か、\n家事全般を趣味としており、当然料理も出来るのだが、\nレウィニアの屋敷に居る時は料理は他の者の役目であり、\n旅の途中の野宿などではその腕を発揮できない。\n結局こういった特殊な状況でしか食事を作る機会が無い為、\n嬉しくて仕方がないのだろう……\nしかし、もし俺が他で食べて来たと言おうものなら、\nその落胆は火を見るより明らかだろう。",
      "en": "I finally understood the meaning of the expression Shuri showed when I entered the inn. Shuri has been working as a servant in my house since she was young, so housework is her hobby, and naturally she can cook as well. But when she is at the Lewinia mansion, cooking is the responsibility of others, and on the road during journeys and camping, she cannot show her skills. In the end, it is only in these special situations that she has a chance to cook, so she must be overjoyed... However, if I were to say I ate elsewhere, her disappointment would be as clear as day."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02605-02606",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Haishera",
      "jp": "（どうやら、此処以外での食事は無理なようだの）",
      "en": "So eating elsewhere is out of the question."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02608-02609",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "（……）",
      "en": "..."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02615-02616",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "お待たせしました",
      "en": "Sorry for the wait."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02618-02618",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "そうこうしている内にシュリが前菜を持って厨房から出てきた。",
      "en": "As we talked, Shuri came out with appetizers."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02620-02621",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "どうぞ",
      "en": "Here you are."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02623-02624",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "前菜を俺の前に置いたシュリの顔を見ると、\nその顔には至福の笑みが広がっている。",
      "en": "When I looked at Shuri after she served the appetizers,\nI saw a blissful smile spread across her face."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02626-02627",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "どうなさいました？",
      "en": "Is something the matter?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02629-02630",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "いや……なんでもない",
      "en": "No... it's nothing."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02632-02633",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "？",
      "en": "Huh?"
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02639-02649",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "食事も終わり部屋に引き上げた俺はシュリの入れてくれた\n紅茶を飲んでいた。\n茶の味も茶器類もレウィニアの屋敷に居る時と\n全く同じ物が用意されている。\n道理で荷物が多かった訳だ……\nカチャッ\n俺が紅茶を飲み終わったのを見ると、戸口に控えていた\nシュリが進み出てきて、茶器類を片付け始めた。",
      "en": "After dinner, I drank the tea Shuri made.\nThe taste and tea set were just like at Lewinia.\nNo wonder her luggage was so heavy... Clink.\nSeeing I finished, Shuri cleared the cups."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02651-02652",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "シュリ",
      "en": "Shuri."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02654-02655",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "はい",
      "en": "Yes."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02657-02657",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "俺の呼びかけにシュリはすぐに答えを返す。",
      "en": "Shuri responded to my call at once."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02659-02660",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Celica",
      "jp": "今日はもうお休み",
      "en": "Rest for today."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02662-02663",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "……はい、畏まりました",
      "en": "...Yes, understood."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02665-02665",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "一瞬の逡巡の後シュリは茶器を手に頭を下げた。",
      "en": "Shuri hesitated, then bowed, tea things in hand."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02667-02668",
      "page_role": "dialogue",
      "speaker_en": "Shuri",
      "jp": "お休みなさいませ、御主人様",
      "en": "Good night, Master."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02673-02690",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "扉の前でもう一度深々と礼をすると、シュリは音も無く\n部屋から出て行き、俺はベッドの上に横になって\n今日の昼間得た情報を整理する事にした\n同盟者たる水の巫女の要請による十八年前に\n行方不明になった王女の探索……\n其の王女らしき者は夜な夜な人間の男を襲い精気を吸い取り\n街外れの廃坑に帰って行くという\n俺と同じく、任務として王女探索の為騎士団を率いて\nこの街に来たレヴィアは其のラティナ王女を追って、\n明日から魔物の住むという其の廃坑に探索に行くという\n当然、俺もそれに習い廃坑に赴く事になるだろう……\n療養のつもりでこの仕事を引き受けはしたが……\nどうやら簡単な人捜しには終わってくれないらしい……\n俺はベッドに横になったまま、そっと胸に手を当ててみる……\n其処には男の俺には有る筈の無い柔らかな二つの膨らみ",
      "en": "Shuri bowed deeply once more, then silently left. I lay on the bed to review the day's news. My ally, the Water Priestess, wants me to find a princess lost eighteen years... She preys on men at night, draining them before returning to a mine. Levia, with her knights, is after Princess Ratina. Tomorrow she'll explore the monster-filled mine. I'll do the same and head there... I meant this job as rest, but it's not simple. Lying still, I gently touch my chest... Two soft mounds that a man shouldn't have."
    },
    {
      "block_id": "s1:block:02692-02698",
      "page_role": "narration",
      "speaker_en": null,
      "jp": "先の大戦で受けた傷は俺から多くの力を奪い、俺という存在を\n人の領域まで衰えさせ……\n其の結果、俺の身体は本来の持ち主である女神によって\n侵食されつつある……\nある神の神官はこれを神殺しという大罪を犯した俺に対する\n断罪だと言っていたな",
      "en": "The wounds I suffered in the last great war robbed me of much strength, and my very existence has declined to a mortal level... As a result, my body is being eroded by the goddess who originally owned it... A priest of a certain god said this was divine punishment for the great sin of god-slaying I committed."
    }
  ]
}
